items.headline: No. 2 Utah survives, stays unbeaten on late 70-yard TD in thriller vs. Arizona
items.description: In a back-and-forth thriller, Utah rallied to remain undefeated after Devon Dampier hit Creed Whittemore on a 70-yard score late in a 40-39 win over Arizona.

items.headline: Patience starting to run thin for head coaches in Week 11
items.description: Saturday didn't offer much to change the season's complexion, but some coaches are coming under pressure.
